title: 671. 4 Keys Keyboard

examples.explanation: Type, type, type, select, copy, paste, paste: 3 -> 6 -> 9.

hints: Let dp[i] be the best screen size with i presses; typing once more always gives dp[i-1] + 1.
Alternatively stop typing at some j, spend 2 presses on select+copy, then paste (i - j - 2) times to reach dp[j] * (i - j - 1).
Take the best j with at least one paste (j <= i - 3).
